tips.title: Maximize Dining Rewards
tips.content: Earn 1.5 Aeroplan points per $1 spent on dining and food delivery, ideal for frequent diners.

tips.title: Air Canada Purchases
tips.content: Get 2 Aeroplan points per $1 spent on Air Canada and Air Canada Vacations, maximizing travel rewards.

tips.title: Optimal Point Redemption
tips.content: Redeem Aeroplan points for flights to get the best value, ideally above 1.29 cents per point.

tips.title: Free Checked Bags
tips.content: Enjoy a free first checked bag for yourself and up to 8 companions on Air Canada flights.

tips.title: Comprehensive Travel Insurance
tips.content: Benefit from extensive travel insurance, including lost baggage and trip accident coverage.

tips.title: High Interest Rate Warning
tips.content: Avoid carrying a balance; the charge card has a steep 30% APR on unpaid balances.

tips.title: Combine with Other Cards
tips.content: Consider pairing with a card that offers higher rewards on everyday purchases for better overall value.
